title: Kannal Pesava
desc: A musician starts recollecting his past when a film director explains a scene to him. Meanwhile, he falls in love with a singer who ignores him at first and relents later.

title: Ayudha Poojai
desc: Krishnasamy becomes rich by indulging in illegal activities, but his wife and daughter, Amudha, leave him due to his work. However, after some years, he strives to change and reunite with his family.

title: Love Today
desc: Ganesh is obsessively in love with Sandhya, but she is not interested in him. Despite facing rejection, he keeps pursuing her, which leads to him losing everything he holds dear.

title: Thee
desc: Brothers Raja and Ravi go down different paths in life and are forced to confront each other.

title: Sabari
desc: Sabarivasan, a cardiologist, works in a government hospital during the day and runs a clinic at night. He attracts the enmity of a local goon when he gets the goon's partner arrested.

title: Adharmam
desc: Dharma is a sandalwood smuggler who plants a sapling for every tree he chops. After his death, his brother Arjuna handles the business and asserts that the state is responsible for the rise in crime.

title: Mudhal Kanave
desc: Hari takes up painting to earn a living in Kanyakumari when he meets and falls in love with Jennifer. But things take an unexpected turn when he discovers that she is already married.

title: Muthal Seethanam
desc: A man falls in love with a wise woman after she changes his perspective on life. However, a surprising turn of events causes them to part ways.

title: Fillers
desc: A comprehensive compilation of promotional videos and trailers of Bollywood movies featuring popular actors and actresses.

title: Karuppu Roja
desc: After falling in love, Vinodh manipulates Tulasi into marriage. However, once their first child is born, he kidnaps the infant, intending to sacrifice him to Satan in a bid to cure his mother.
